args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (18% error rate).
2. **Rolled back**: All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) reverted to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. (Note: v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging, but that's a staging-only release and not a candidate for production rollback.)
3. **Verified**: Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions with error rate at 0.2%.
4. **Incident**: Opened a SEV2 incident for checkout-api describing the failed deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
